setup: Oh, you're a morning person? I guess that explains why you're so annoying before 10 AM.

setup: I'm not argumentative, I'm just explaining why I'm right.
punchline: There's a big difference.

setup: I'm not a pro-crastinator, I'm a pro-pro-crastinator.
punchline: I've been meaning to get my certification, but I'll do it tomorrow.

setup: I'm not lazy, I'm just highly motivated to do nothing.
punchline: It's a very specific skillset.

setup: Oh, you're looking for your patience? I think I saw it leaving about ten minutes ago.
punchline: It didn't leave a note.

setup: I'm not saying you're an idiot, but you're definitely the reason we have instructions on shampoo bottles.
punchline: Lather, rinse, repeat... maybe you'll get it next time.

setup: I'm not a scientist, but even I can tell that your brain is mostly filler.
punchline: It's a very impressive void.

setup: Oh, you're a 'free spirit'? I guess that's the modern term for 'unemployed and lives with parents'.
punchline: So adventurous.

setup: I'm not being rude, I'm just being honest. There's a difference, though you might not be smart enough to see it.
punchline: Oops, was that too honest?

setup: How many surrealists does it take to change a lightbulb?
punchline: A fish.

setup: A man walks into a library and asks for a glass of water.
punchline: The librarian says, 'This is a library.' The man whispers, 'I'm sorry. May I have a glass of water?'

setup: What’s the difference between a duck?
punchline: One of its legs is both the same.

setup: What’s red and bad for your teeth?
punchline: A brick.

setup: I answered the door this morning.
punchline: I felt like a complete idiot when I realized it hadn't said anything.

setup: What’s big, white, and can’t climb trees?
punchline: A fridge.

setup: I had a dream that I was a muffler.
punchline: I woke up exhausted.

setup: I saw a man in a boat with a dog, but he had no oars.
punchline: I asked how he moved. He said 'The dog is a retriever'.

setup: What’s blue and smells like red paint?
punchline: Blue paint.

setup: I bought a pair of shoes from a drug dealer.
punchline: I don't know what he laced them with, but I've been tripping all day.

setup: What's green and has wheels?
punchline: Grass. I lied about the wheels.

setup: What do you call a man with a shovel on his head?
punchline: Doug.

setup: What do you call a man without a shovel on his head?
punchline: Douglas.

setup: I'm reading a book about gravity.
punchline: It's impossible to put down, but the ending is a bit of a letdown.

setup: What's the difference between a piano and a fish?
punchline: You can't tuna fish.

setup: I was going to tell a joke about a time machine.
punchline: But you guys didn't like it tomorrow.

setup: Why do birds fly south for the winter?
punchline: Because it's too far to walk.

setup: What's the difference between a elephant and a grape?
punchline: Grapes are purple.

setup: What do you call a cow with no legs?
punchline: Ground beef.

setup: Why did the banana go to the doctor?
punchline: Because it wasn't peeling well.

setup: What has keys but can't open locks?
punchline: A piano.

setup: What is full of holes but still holds water?
punchline: A sponge.

setup: I’m tall when I’m young, and I’m short when I’m old. What am I?
punchline: A candle.

setup: What can travel around the world while staying in a corner?
punchline: A stamp.

setup: What month of the year has 28 days?
punchline: All of them.

setup: What comes once in a minute, twice in a moment, but never in a thousand years?
punchline: The letter M.

setup: What has a head and a tail but no body?
punchline: A coin.

setup: What gets wet while drying?
punchline: A towel.

setup: Which word in the dictionary is spelled incorrectly?
punchline: Incorrectly.

setup: What has a neck but no head?
punchline: A bottle.

setup: What has to be broken before you can use it?
punchline: An egg.

setup: I’m light as a feather, yet the strongest man can’t hold me for much more than a minute. What am I?
punchline: Breath.

setup: What has hands but can’t clap?
punchline: A clock.

setup: What can you catch but not throw?
punchline: A cold.

setup: What has one eye but can’t see?
punchline: A needle.

setup: What belongs to you but others use it more than you do?
punchline: Your name.

setup: What is so fragile that saying its name breaks it?
punchline: Silence.

setup: I have cities, but no houses. I have mountains, but no trees. I have water, but no fish. What am I?
punchline: A map.

setup: What has many teeth but can’t bite?
punchline: A comb.

setup: What has a thumb and four fingers but is not alive?
punchline: A glove.
